secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: HMAC key for access tokens and signed OAuth state.
secrets.rotate: yearly, or immediately if leaked (all sessions end)

secrets.name: JWT_ISSUER
secrets.description: iss claim, e.g. your API hostname.
secrets.generate: choose a stable string such as api.example.com

secrets.name: JWT_AUDIENCE
secrets.description: aud claim, e.g. your app name.

secrets.name: WEB_ORIGIN
secrets.description: Browser origin(s) allowed to use cookie sessions; comma-separated in WEB_ORIGINS for several.

secrets.name: AUTH_URL
secrets.description: Public URL of the mounted auth router, used to build OAuth redirect URIs.

secrets.name: OTP_PEPPER
secrets.description: Server-side pepper mixed into one-time-code hashes.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: OAuth 2.0 Web client id; also used as serverClientId by native apps.
secrets.generate: Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials > Create OAuth client (Web). Add AUTH_URL/google/callback as an authorised redirect URI.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret of the same Web client.
secrets.generate: shown once when the client is created

secrets.name: APPLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Services ID (web) e.g. com.example.web. Native apps send the bundle id; list those in APPLE_BUNDLE_IDS.
secrets.generate: Apple Developer > Identifiers > Services IDs > enable Sign in with Apple, add the domain and AUTH_URL/apple/callback as return URL.

secrets.name: APPLE_KEY_ID
secrets.description: Key id of the Sign in with Apple key.
secrets.generate: Apple Developer > Keys > create key with Sign in with Apple enabled

secrets.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.description: Contents of the downloaded AuthKey_XXXX.p8 (PEM). Downloadable only once.
secrets.generate: download when creating the key; paste the whole PEM including BEGIN/END lines
secrets.rotate: keys do not expire, but the client secret JWT is re-minted per request

secrets.name: APPLE_BUNDLE_IDS
secrets.description: Comma-separated iOS/macOS bundle ids accepted as ID-token audiences for native sign-in.
secrets.when: apple enabled and a native app signs in

secrets.name: RP_ID
secrets.description: WebAuthn relying-party id: the registrable domain shared by web and app (e.g. example.com). Never changes once users have passkeys.

secrets.name: RP_NAME
secrets.description: Name shown in the passkey prompt.
